title: Review the complete Engram and TermAl test portfolios after sync
outcome: Review the complete Engram and TermAl test portfolios after sync
acceptance: Both projects produce a concrete test-portfolio review classifying keep, simplify or remove with a reason and priority for each finding

The review covers observable behavior versus implementation mirroring, brittleness and internal-detail coupling, cost and timeout versus benchmark character, and redundant duplication or an unnecessarily expensive proof level
Source-text and source-shape findings feed from the existing inventories without confusing source_id input identity with a metric test
The resulting recommendations have named implementation owners in the appropriate project tracker and introduce no new gate or mandatory replacement suite
The review starts after the current sync landings and does not block them
